chunks: And meat of birds from whatever they desire.
ai.seo_question: What kind of meat is available in Paradise according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Ad-Dukhan is often interpreted alongside the concept of 'Lahm al-Tayr' (meat of birds) as a distinct, pure sustenance free from the impurities associated with earthly consumption. Scholars highlight that this variety caters to the refined tastes of the righteous, reflecting the divine generosity where food is provided according to individual desire without the need for preparation or digestion. This detail underscores the transition from earthly limitations to the boundless, customized blessings of Jannah.
